7114.title: Short-base ref precedence includes upstream changes
7114.rootCauseOneLine: Short-base resolution returns an older local ref before considering the available origin tracking ref, so upstream-only commits enter the comparison.

prReviews.topFinding: Unconditional remote-first ordering also changes documented newer-local behavior; PR was reviewed statically only and is closed/unmerged.

7114.proposedFix: Decide short-name precedence versus an explicit remote default, preserve explicit-local and local-only behavior, then test and document the selected policy.
7114.caveats: Two real-Git backend reproductions; no macOS desktop UI check. No automatic fix because the documented/tested default needs a product-policy decision.
